projects.title: Enterprise NFR Work Fabric
projects.evidenceType: Private blueprint and interactive experience, sanitised
projects.summary: A strategic, operating-model, architecture and experience blueprint for connected non-financial-risk work across eight process families, built as a 22-scene interactive executive experience with explorer deep dives, acceptance tests and accessibility checks.
projects.commercial: Replaces isolated AI use cases with one persistent work object, permissioned role views and a shared, governed fabric, with a federated operating model and a roadmap that grows by process cluster.
projects.scopeBoundary: Synthetic scenarios only; client identity and internal materials excluded. A blueprint, not a deployed system.

projects.title: Enterprise AI Economics Simulator
projects.summary: Executive cost model for a shared AI platform: allocation across the functions sharing it, maturity, hosting, governance staffing, licences and usage, with a ten-year cash flow and break-even.
projects.commercial: At its illustrative defaults, fixed platform and governance costs are about 96 percent of year-one cost and tokens under 1 percent, which moves the business case from token prices to sharing, maturity and hosting.
projects.scopeBoundary: Illustrative planning assumptions and placeholder benchmarks. Not a client tool, a proposal or a production system.

projects.title: DORA Article 12 AI Control Line
projects.summary: Takes one regulatory obligation through guideline, control, infrastructure proposal, policy verification, documentation and evidence, with an explicit state machine, three human approval gates and hash-linked provenance.
projects.commercial: Shows how regulatory change can stay traceable and human-approved end to end, with task-based model assignment and deterministic verification before review.
projects.scopeBoundary: Synthetic fixtures; cloud, deployment and register integrations simulated; client context excluded.

projects.title: Enterprise NFR Agent Platform
projects.summary: Eighteen NFR domain agents on one orchestrator, sharing a run lifecycle, a role-gated approval step, typed write-back to a ServiceNow developer instance and an observability gateway.
projects.commercial: Each additional NFR domain costs mostly prompts and data, because lifecycle, approval, write-back and audit are built once.
projects.scopeBoundary: Synthetic data and a developer instance. Not a production deployment.

projects.title: AIRLOCK Regulated AI Workload Foundry
projects.evidenceType: Local prototype and cloud reference architecture
projects.summary: A pattern for auditable, policy-gated AI workloads: a deterministic finance engine, a 12-stage workflow and approval records, with the AWS layer kept as reference architecture.
projects.commercial: Makes evaluation, approval and release reusable for the next regulated workload instead of rebuilding controls per pilot.
projects.scopeBoundary: Synthetic data and a scripted model; the Terraform layer has never been applied.
